9800.meaning1: mixed up with the impure; contaminated with impurities
9800.meaning2: mixed with or associated with impurity or the impure

examples.text: ye idha kāmesu asaññatā janā, rasesu giddhā asucīkamissitā, n'atthikadiṭṭhī visamā durannayā, es'āmagandho na hi maṃsabhojanaṃ.
api my'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, parisā suññā viya khāyati parinibbutesu sāriputtamoggallānesu. asuññā me, bhikkhave, parisā hoti, anapekkhā tassaṃ disāyaṃ hoti, yassaṃ disāyaṃ sāriputtamoggallānā viharanti.

9802.meaning1: which is not empty; which has something remaining
9802.construction:
na > a + suñña + tā + a
asuññatā + a
9802.commentary: (MNt) ekabhāvaṃ ekaṃ asuññatan'ti paccatte upayogavacanaṃ, ekattaṃ eko asuññato'ti attho.

examples.text: so suññam'idaṃ saññāgataṃ gāmasaññāyā'ti pajānāti, suññam'idaṃ saññāgataṃ manussasaññāyā'ti pajānāti, atthi c'ev'idaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ, araññasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan'ti.

9803.grammar: prp of na suṇāti, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno dhammaṃ asuṇantī yena so bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi.

9804.commentary: (VINa) asutaṃ nāma tath'eva kenaci vuccamānaṃ na sutaṃ.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato… sutvā sotabbaṃ, sutaṃ na maññati, asutaṃ na maññati, sotabbaṃ na maññati, sotāraṃ na maññati
disā catasso vidisā catasso, uddhaṃ adho dasa disā imāyo, na tuyhaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ asutaṃ amutaṃ, atho aviññātaṃ kiñcanam'atthi loke, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.

9805.meaning1: who speaks about the unheard; who states what one has not heard (as)

examples.text: aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, ariyavohārā. katame aṭṭha? adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, asute asutavāditā, amute amutavāditā, aviññāte aviññātavāditā, diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā.

9806.meaning1: who speaks about the unheard; who states what one has not heard (as)

examples.text: adiṭṭhe diṭṭhavādī hoti, asute sutavādī hoti, amute mutavādī hoti, aviññāte viññātavādī hoti… adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavādī hoti, asute asutavādī hoti, amute amutavādī hoti, aviññāte aviññātavādī hoti.
patirūpako mattikākuṇḍalo'va, loh'aḍḍhamāso'va suvaṇṇachanno, caranti loke parivārachannā, anto asuddhā bahi sobhamānā'ti.
pāturahosi magadhesu pubbe, dhammo asuddho samalehi cintito, apāpur'etaṃ amatassa dvāraṃ, suṇantu dhammaṃ vimalen'ānubuddhaṃ.

9809.meaning1: believing to be impure; regarding (someone) as at fault

examples.text: anāpatti suddhe asuddhadiṭṭhissa, asuddhe asuddhadiṭṭhissa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

9810.grammar: fem, abstr, from na sujjhati, neg
9810.commentary: (NIDD1) asuddhin'ti asuddhiṃ patthenti, akusale dhamme patthenti. (DHPa) akusalakammasaṅkhātā ca asuddhi paccattaṃ kārakasattānaṃ attani'y'eva vipaccati.

examples.text: attanā hi kataṃ pāpaṃ, attanā saṃkilissati, attanā akataṃ pāpaṃ, attanā'va visujjhati, suddhī asuddhi paccattaṃ, n'āñño aññaṃ visodhaye.
sīlabbataṃ vā'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, kammañ'ca sāvajj'anavajjam'etaṃ, suddhiṃ asuddhin'ti apatthayāno, virato care santim'anuggahāya.

9811.meaning1: not a bitch; not a female dog; animal of another species

examples.text: eta'r'ahi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇim'pi gacchanti, abrāhmaṇim'pi gacchanti. eta'r'ahi, bhikkhave, sunakhā sunakhiṃ'y'eva gacchanti, no asunakhiṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo eta'r'ahi sunakhesu sandissati, no brāhmaṇesu.
anattani, bhikkhave, attā'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso. asubhe, bhikkhave, subhan'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
yāvakīvañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū asubhasaññaṃ bhāvessanti

9814.grammar: nt, abstr, from na sobhati, neg

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti, asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
asubhaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. asubhañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yo rāgo so pahīyissati.

9816.meaning1: talk on ugliness; discussion about foulness

examples.text: atha kho te bhikkhū, bhagavā anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti, asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatī'ti anek'ākāravokāraṃ asubhabhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti.

9819.meaning1: saw as ugly; perceived as unattractive

examples.text: aniccaṃ aniccato dakkhuṃ, dukkham'addakkhu dukkhato, anattani anattā'ti, asubhaṃ asubhat'addasuṃ, sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti

na > a + √subh + a + tā
asubha + tā

9821.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of na subha, neg
9821.meaning1: as ugly; as disgusting; as unattractive
9821.construction:
na > a + √subh + a + to
asubha + to

examples.text: anattani anattā'ti, asubhaṃ asubhat'addasuṃ, sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti.
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā kāmacchando n'uppajjati uppanno vā kāmacchando pahīyati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, asubhanimittaṃ

9824.meaning1: devotion to a repulsive meditation object; practice of corpse meditation

examples.text: dasa'y'ime, bhikkhave, kaṇṭakā. katame dasa? pavivek'ārāmassa saṅgaṇik'ārāmatā kaṇṭako, asubhanimitt'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa subhanimitt'ānuyogo kaṇṭako
asubhanimitt'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa kho, nāgita, subhanimitte pāṭikulyatā saṇṭhāti, eso tassa nissando.

9825.meaning1: meditation on ugliness; meditation on unattractiveness

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti, asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.

9826.meaning1: devoted to the development of ugliness; engaged in the cultivation of (the perception of) unattractiveness

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe asubhabhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.

9827.meaning1: perception of unattractiveness; notion of impurity (in); concept of ugliness
9827.notes: ten peceptions 1. aniccasaññā, 2. anattasaññā, 3. asubhasaññā, 4. ādīnavasaññā, 5. pahānasaññā, 6. virāgasaññā, 7. nirodhasaññā, 8. sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, 9. sabbasaṅkhāresu anicchāsaññā, 10. ānāpānassati.

examples.text: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. katamā pañca? asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
asubhasaññā, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā'ti. iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?

9828.meaning1: fortified by the perception of unattractiveness
9828.commentary: (VINt) asubhasaññāparicitenā'ti sakalaṃ kāyaṃ asubhan'ti pavattāya saññāya sahagatattā jhānaṃ asubhasaññā, tena paricitena paribhāvitena.

examples.text: asubhasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.

9834.commentary: (ANa) asubh'ānupassī kāye viharatī'ti attano karajakāye, yathā etaṃ, tathā idan'ti iminā nayena bahiddhā diṭṭhānaṃ dasannaṃ asubhānaṃ upasaṃharaṇavasena asubh'ānupassī viharati, attano kāyaṃ asubhato paṭikūlato ñāṇena passatī'ti attho.

examples.text: asubh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu susaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi ca mattaññuṃ, saddhaṃ āraddhavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve nappasahati māro, vāto selaṃ'va pabbataṃ.
etha, tumhe, bhikkhave, asubh'ānupassino kāye viharatha, āhāre paṭikūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassino'ti.

9836.meaning1: titan; anti-god; enemy of the devas
9836.commentary: (UDa) pakatidevā viya na suranti na isanti na virocantīti asurā, surā nāma devā, tesaṃ paṭipakkhāti vā asurā, vepacitti-pahārād'ādayo.

examples.text: tena sudaṃ, bhante, devatā tāvatiṃsā attamanā honti pamuditā pītisomanassajātā dibbā vata bho kāyā paripūrenti, hāyanti asurakāyā'ti
eko'va indo asure jināti, eko'va seno hanti dije pasayha, eko'va byaggho migasaṅghapatto, varaṃ varaṃ hanti balañ'hi tādisaṃ.
sakkassa, bhikkhave, devānam'indassa sujā nāma asurakaññā pajāpati, tasmā sujampatī'ti vuccati.

9838.meaning1: horde of asuras; host of daemons
9838.meaning2: nation or an assembly of Asuras

examples.text: tena sudaṃ, bhante, devatā tāvatiṃsā attamanā honti pamuditā pītisomanassajātā dibbā vata bho kāyā paripūrenti, hāyanti asurakāyā'ti

9839.meaning1: with a retinue of anti-gods; surrounded by daemons

examples.text: katame cattāro? asuro asuraparivāro, asuro devaparivāro, devo asuraparivāro, devo devaparivāro.

9840.meaning1: castle of the asuras; city of the titans

examples.text: sace, mārisā, dev'āsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe asurā jineyyuṃ devā parājineyyuṃ, yena naṃ sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha asurapuran'ti.
dhammikā kho asurā, adhammikā devā, tatth'eva dān'āhaṃ asurapuraṃ gamissāmī'ti, atha kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi baddhaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati, dibbehi ca pañcahi kāmaguṇehi parihāyati.

9841.meaning1: battle between asuras (and); clash of the titans (with)

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo asure āmantesi, sace, mārisā, devānaṃ asurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe asurā jineyyuṃ devā parājineyyuṃ, yena naṃ sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha asurapuran'ti.

9844.meaning1: master of the daemons; Lord of the Dark Ones

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, dev'āsurasaṅgāmo samupabyūḷho ahosi. atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo asure āmantesi
tena kho pana samayena candimā devaputto rāhunā asur'indena gahito hoti. atha kho candimā devaputto bhagavantaṃ anussaramāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

9845.meaning1: related to the lord of the daemons

9846.meaning1: name of a Brahman; one of three brothers

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bhagavā tuṇhī ahosi. atha kho asur'indakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, jito'si, samaṇa, jito'si, samaṇā'ti.

9848.notes: MW suṣira having a good tube or channel

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano. atha puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi n'eva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya

examples.text: visaṃvādanā mittānaṃ paripantho, asajjhāyakiriyā bāhusaccassa paripantho, asussūsā aparipucchā paññāya paripantho

asūci + ka

9855.meaning1: who does not require any further training; beyond training
9855.meaning2: one who does not require any further training; an Arahant; one beyond training
9855.commentary: (ADha) apariyositasikkhattā sayam'eva sikkhantī'ti'pi sekkhā. upari sikkhitabbābhāvato na sekkhā'ti asekkhā. vuḍḍhippattā vā sekkhā'ti'pi asekkhā. arahattaphaladhammānaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tatiyapadaṃ ubhayapaṭikkhepena vuttaṃ.

examples.text: sekkhā dhammā. asekkhā dhammā. n'eva sekkhā na-asekkhā dhammā.
asekkhasammate vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. asekkhasammate asekkhasammatasaññī, anāpatti.

9858.meaning1: perceiving (a family) as not designated as in training

examples.text: asekkhasammate vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. asekkhasammate asekkhasammatasaññī, anāpatti.

9859.commentary: (VINa) sekkhadhamme atikkamma aggaphale ṭhito, tato uttari sikkhitabbābhāvato khīṇ'āsavo, asekho'ti vuccati.

examples.text: samaññāya bhikkhu, paṭiññāya bhikkhu, ehi bhikkhū'ti bhikkhu, tīhi saraṇagamanehi upasampanno'ti bhikkhu, bhadro bhikkhu, sāro bhikkhu, sekho bhikkhu, asekho bhikkhu

9860.meaning1: who does not require any further training
9860.meaning2: who does not require any further training

examples.text: tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, atthi nu kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma sekho bhikkhu sekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito sekho'smī'ti pajāneyya, asekho bhikkhu asekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito asekho'smī'ti pajāneyyā'ti?

9861.meaning1: understanding of an adept; knowledge of an arahant

examples.text: asekhañāṇam'uppannaṃ, antimo'yaṃ samussayo, yo sāro brahmacariyassa, tasmiṃ aparapaccayā.

9862.meaning1: stage of one beyond training; arahant level

examples.text: tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, atthi nu kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma sekho bhikkhu sekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito sekho'smī'ti pajāneyya, asekho bhikkhu asekhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito asekho'smī'ti pajāneyyā'ti?

evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso jighacchādubbalyapareto madhupiṇḍikaṃ adhigaccheyya, so yato yato sāyeyya, labheth'eva sādurasaṃ asecanakaṃ

asecanaka + tta

9866.meaning1: pure and nourishing; delicious and nutritious
9866.commentary: (SNa) asecanakam'ojavan'ti anāsittakaṃ ojavantaṃ. yathā hi bāhirāni asambhinnapāyās'ādīni'pi sappimadhusakkharāhi āsittāni yojitān'eva madhurāni ojavantāni honti, na evam'ayaṃ dhammo. ayaṃ hi attano dhammatāya madhuro c'eva ojavā ca, na aññena upasitto. ten'āha asecanakam'ojavan'ti. (THIa) asecanakam'ojavan'ti kenaci anāsittakaṃ ojavantaṃ sabhāvamadhuraṃ sabbassā'pi kilesarogassa vūpasaman'osadhabhūtaṃ ariyamaggaṃ, nibbānam'eva vā. ariyamaggam'pi hi nibbān'atthikehi paṭipajjitabbato kilesapariḷāhābhāvato ca padaṃ santan'ti vattuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: bhikkhunī sīlasampannā, indriyesu susaṃvutā, adhigacche padaṃ santaṃ, asecanakam'ojavaṃ.
tañ'ca pana appaṭivānīyaṃ, asecanakam'ojavaṃ, pivanti maññe sappaññā, valāhakam'iva panthagū'ti.
avijjāya tv'eva asesavirāganirodhā saṅkhāranirodho, saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho
yassa vitakkā vidhūpitā, ajjhattaṃ suvikappitā asesā, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

asesa + to

paṭilomakathāyaṃ pana avijjāya tv'evā'ti avijjāya tu eva. asesavirāganirodhā'ti virāgasaṅkhātena maggena asesanirodhā. saṅkhāranirodho'ti saṅkhārānaṃ anuppādanirodho hoti.

etadānuttariyaṃ, bhante, kusalesu dhammesu. taṃ bhagavā asesam'abhijānāti, taṃ bhagavato asesam'abhijānato uttari abhiññeyyaṃ n'atthi, yadabhijānaṃ añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo'bhiññataro assa, yadidaṃ kusalesu dhammesu.

avijjāya tv'eva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho, santam'etaṃ padaṃ paṇītam'etaṃ padaṃ, yadidaṃ, sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.

9880.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from na sevati, neg (+gen)
9880.meaning1: not associating; having nothing to do (with)

examples.text: asevanā ca bālānaṃ, paṇḍitānañ'ca sevanā, pūjā ca pūjanīyānaṃ, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

9881.grammar: prp of na sevati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: tassa asevitabbe dhamme sevato sevitabbe dhamme asevato, abhajitabbe dhamme bhajato bhajitabbe dhamme abhajato aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dhammā parihāyanti.

9882.grammar: prp of na sevati, neg, trans (+acc)
9882.meaning1: not practising; not engaging (in); not cultivating

examples.text: tasmā hi dhīro idh'upaṭṭhitassatī, kāme ca pāpe ca asevamāno, sahā'pi dukkhena jaheyya kāme, paṭisotagāmī'ti tam'āhu puggalaṃ.

9883.meaning1: should not be associated with; should not be affiliated with; should not be partaken of

examples.text: cīvaram'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi, sevitabbam'pi asevitabbam'pi. piṇḍapātam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi, sevitabbam'pi asevitabbam'pi.
idha, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano… sevitabbe dhamme na jānāti asevitabbe dhamme na jānāti, bhajitabbe dhamme na jānāti abhajitabbe dhamme na jānāti.

9884.meaning1: considered not to be associated with; reckoned as not to be partaken of
9884.meaning2: considered as not to be associated with; reckoned as not to be partaken of

examples.text: ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā akusalā akusalasaṅkhātā, sāvajjā sāvajjasaṅkhātā, asevitabbā asevitabbasaṅkhātā, na alam'ariyā na alam'ariyasaṅkhātā, kaṇhā kaṇhasaṅkhātā.
phuṭṭhassa lokadhammehi, cittaṃ yassa na kampati, asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
yesaṃ ekaṃ piyaṃ, ekaṃ tesaṃ dukkhaṃ, yesaṃ n'atthi piyaṃ, n'atthi tesaṃ dukkhaṃ, asokā te virajā anupāyāsā'ti vadāmī'ti
vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi agg'upaṭṭhāko.

9888.grammar: fem, abstr, from na soka, neg
9888.construction:

9888.commentary: (THa) ko vā tava ācariyo kassa sāsanaṃ, ovādaṃ nissāya ayaṃ asokatā maraṇakāle sok'ābhāvo labbhatī'ti

examples.text: kiṃ bhadante karitvāna, ko vā ācariyo tava, kassa sāsanam'āgamma, labbhate taṃ asokatā.
ten'āyaṃ desito dhammo, khayagāmī anuttaro, tassa sāsanam'āgamma, labbhate taṃ asokatā.

9889.grammar: prp of na socati, neg, intrans
9889.commentary: (SNa) asocaṃ asocāpayan'ti asocantena asocāpayantena. iti bhagavā adhammikarājūnaṃ rajje vijite daṇḍakarapīḷite manusse disvā kāruññavasena evaṃ cintesi.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretuṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenā'ti?

9890.grammar: prp of na socati, neg, intrans
9890.meaning1: not mourning; not grieving; free from sorrow

examples.text: sokassa mūlaṃ palikhāya sabbaṃ, anāgu jhāyāmi asocamāno, chetvāna sabbaṃ bhavalobhajappaṃ, anāsavo jhāyāmi pamattabandhū'ti.

9891.commentary: (SNa) asocaṃ asocāpayan'ti asocantena asocāpayantena. iti bhagavā adhammikarājūnaṃ rajje vijite daṇḍakarapīḷite manusse disvā kāruññavasena evaṃ cintesi.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretuṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenā'ti?

9892.grammar: nt, abstr, from na suci, neg

examples.text: tividhaṃ kho, cunda, kāyena asoceyyaṃ hoti, catubbidhaṃ vācāya asoceyyaṃ hoti, tividhaṃ manasā asoceyyaṃ hoti.

9893.construction:
na > a + soṇḍa + ī
asoṇḍa + ī

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattā āharati dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā taṃ ārakkhena guttiyā sampādeti, tattha ca hoti adhuttī athenī asoṇḍī avināsikā.
siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ, pukkuso abhihārayi, tena acchādito satthā, hemavaṇṇo asobhathā'ti.

kusāvatī, ānanda, rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā c'eva rattiñ'ca, seyyath'idaṃ, hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena bherisaddena mudiṅgasaddena vīṇāsaddena gītasaddena saṅkhasaddena sammasaddena pāṇitāḷasaddena asnātha pivatha khādathā'ti dasamena saddena.
attanā hi kataṃ pāpaṃ, attajaṃ attasambhavaṃ, abhimatthati dummedhaṃ, vajiraṃ'v'asmamayaṃ maṇiṃ.
paribbaja mahābrahme, pacant'aññe'pi pāṇino, mā tvaṃ adhammo ācarito, asmā kumbham'iv'ābhidā'ti.
